description: The Honorable Audra Riley is the Presiding Judge of Criminal District Court No. 3 in Dallas County, Texas. She was elected by Dallas County voters in 2018 and was sworn in on January 1, 2019. Judge Audra Riley, a lifelong Democrat, intends to run for re-election during the 2024 election cycle.
